name: Negative test vectors for SD-JWT VC presentations under OpenID4VP 1.0 and HAIP 1.0
warning: TEST KEYS AND CERTIFICATES, derived from public seeds by make_vectors.py. Never trust them.

layers.control: the controls, which every verifier judges
layers.jose: JWS rules (RFC 7515, 7518, 8725) any JOSE verifier applies
layers.sd-jwt: RFC 9901, which any SD-JWT verifier applies
layers.sd-jwt-vc: the SD-JWT VC profile, which a verifier of SD-JWT VCs applies
layers.openid4vp: OpenID4VP 1.0, which a verifier receiving presentations over it applies
layers.haip-x509: the issuer's x5c chain under HAIP 1.0 and RFC 5280, which a verifier resolving keys from x5c applies

classes.control: a valid presentation: a correct verifier accepts it
classes.spec: a sentence of the cited text requires the refusal
classes.spec-implied: the cited sentence binds the issuer or the wallet, or a definition implies the refusal

vectors.changed: nothing: the control, issuer key from x5c chaining to the anchor
nothing: the control, issuer key given as a JWK
the issuer JWT's header marks an extension critical

clauses.text: If any of the listed extension Header Parameters are not understood and supported by the recipient, then the JWS is invalid.

vectors.changed: the Key Binding JWT's header marks an extension critical

clauses.text: If any of the listed extension Header Parameters are not understood and supported by the recipient, then the JWS is invalid.

vectors.changed: the Key Binding JWT's aud is an array holding the right identifier

clauses.text: aud: REQUIRED. The value MUST be a single string that identifies the intended receiver of the Key Binding JWT.

vectors.changed: the Key Binding JWT's aud is the Client Identifier without its x509_hash: prefix

clauses.text: the aud claim MUST be the value of the Client Identifier

vectors.changed: the issuer committed to one digest twice

clauses.text: If any digest value is encountered more than once in the Issuer-signed JWT payload (directly or recursively via other Disclosures), the SD-JWT MUST be rejected.

vectors.changed: a Disclosure names a claim the payload already holds in the clear

clauses.text: If the claim name already exists at the level of the _sd key, the SD-JWT MUST be rejected.

vectors.changed: exp travels in a Disclosure instead of the payload

clauses.text: The following registered JWT claims, including any of their sub-claims, when used in the SD-JWT component of an SD-JWT VC, MUST NOT be included in Disclosures and therefore MUST NOT be selectively disclosed

vectors.changed: iss travels in a Disclosure instead of the payload

clauses.text: The following registered JWT claims, including any of their sub-claims, when used in the SD-JWT component of an SD-JWT VC, MUST NOT be included in Disclosures and therefore MUST NOT be selectively disclosed

vectors.changed: an object-property Disclosure with four elements

clauses.text: If the contents of the respective Disclosure is not a JSON array of three elements (salt, claim name, claim value), the SD-JWT MUST be rejected.

vectors.changed: a Disclosure whose claim name is _sd

clauses.text: If the claim name is _sd or ..., the SD-JWT MUST be rejected.

vectors.changed: the Key Binding JWT's typ is JWT

clauses.text: Check that the typ of the Key Binding JWT is kb+jwt (see Section 4.3).

vectors.changed: the Key Binding JWT is unsigned (alg none)

clauses.text: The "none" algorithm MUST NOT be accepted.

vectors.changed: the Key Binding JWT is an HMAC keyed with the holder's public JWK (algorithm confusion)

clauses.text: each key MUST be used with exactly one algorithm, and this MUST be checked when the cryptographic operation is performed.

vectors.changed: the Key Binding JWT's iat is NaN, which is not JSON

clauses.text: Numeric values that cannot be represented in the grammar below (such as Infinity and NaN) are not permitted.

vectors.changed: the Key Binding JWT's exp is a string

clauses.text: Its value MUST be a number containing a NumericDate value.

vectors.changed: the issuer JWT's ES256 signature is DER-encoded instead of R||S

clauses.text: The JWS Signature value MUST be a 64-octet sequence. If it is not a 64-octet sequence, the validation has failed.

vectors.changed: x5c holds only a self-signed leaf

clauses.text: The X.509 certificate signing the request MUST NOT be self-signed.

vectors.changed: x5c carries the trust anchor's own certificate

clauses.text: The X.509 certificate of the trust anchor MUST NOT be included in the x5c JOSE header of the SD-JWT VC.

vectors.changed: the leaf chains to a root the verifier was not given

clauses.text: The recipient MUST validate the certificate chain according to RFC 5280 [RFC5280] and consider the certificate or certificate chain to be invalid if any validation failure occurs.

vectors.changed: the leaf expired before the verification instant

clauses.text: The recipient MUST validate the certificate chain according to RFC 5280 [RFC5280] and consider the certificate or certificate chain to be invalid if any validation failure occurs.
The certificate validity period includes the current time.

vectors.changed: the intermediate in x5c is not a CA

clauses.text: The recipient MUST validate the certificate chain according to RFC 5280 [RFC5280] and consider the certificate or certificate chain to be invalid if any validation failure occurs.
